shots.detail_en: Early-morning elevator in Lianhua Tower; Xiong Wei stands beside an old director, the mirror wall reflecting them both.
shots.sub: 叔，熊家的冬天要来了。您想被雪埋，还是想有炉子？
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: Proxy-solicitation montage: three signatures / teahouse whispers / fountain-pen close-up / the document stack growing.
shots.sub: 家族要避险，先割最大的敞口。他们，都听懂了。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: Printer spits out a cover page: 'Extraordinary Shareholders' Meeting — Motion of Removal.'
Xiong Wei presses the motion into a dossier bag; the hand-copied 'Xiong Family Creed' lies on top.
shots.sub: 程序齐了。还差最后一样——证据。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: Iron door of the old archive opens; in a column of dust light Xiong Wei pulls out a yellowed file.
File cover close-up: 'Lu Zhenhai · 1993' (EP03 planted line recovered).
shots.sub: 爸，当年这一页，是你唯一一次'情绪化'。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: He turns pages past abstract 93 tape silhouettes, stopping at one: 'Witness record: Lianhua Old Hall rooftop, rainy night.'
shots.sub: 这份档案有两份用途——杀一个父亲，或者，卖一个人情。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: He closes the file, lens flare hiding his eyes.
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: Transition: empty hall after close, big screen half dark; Chang Hong stands alone before it (EP01 altar composition mirrored).
Hong Li walks over and slaps a document on the rail before him — her resignation as the alliance's chief analyst.
shots.sub: 账我全部做完了。连我自己那一份，也做完了。
shots.speaker: 沈红利

shots.detail_en: Chang Hong loses a beat, for the first time.
shots.sub: 红利，仗还有三天。我需要你。
shots.speaker: 陆长虹

shots.detail_en: Rain in Hong Li's eyes, her voice does not shake.
shots.sub: 你父亲跳下去之前，最怕的就是——你变成现在这样。
shots.speaker: 沈红利

shots.detail_en: Chang Hong's fingers tighten on the watch chain — the watch that runs one minute slow.
shots.sub: K 线走坏了，可以等反弹。人走坏了……
shots.speaker: 陆长虹

shots.detail_en: Hong Li shakes her head, one last look before turning.
shots.sub: 没有反弹。我等了你三个月——账目上，全是'下一次'。
shots.speaker: 沈红利

shots.detail_en: She turns and leaves, heels echoing through the empty hall; Chang Hong does not look back.
Man Cang steps out from behind a pillar having heard everything, forcing a sheepish grin.
shots.sub: 虹哥……红利姐是不是气我没给她留虾饺？要不，我把我的仓也给你加上？
shots.speaker: 王满仓

shots.detail_en: Chang Hong looks at that smiling face, Adam's apple bobbing.
shots.sub: 满仓，今晚回去……给你爹盛碗汤。
shots.speaker: 陆长虹

shots.detail_en: Transition: Xiong dining room; the father turns his beads after dinner while the son quietly peels an apple in one unbroken ribbon.
The father chuckles about shareholders; mid-sentence the bead string snaps, one bead rolls across the floor.
shots.sub: 股东们近来总提'风险管理'。好——儿子大了，知道怕了。
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: The bead stops at the son's shoe tip; he bends, picks it up, returns it with both hands.
shots.sub: 爸，您的'风险管理'——我来做。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: The father takes the bead back, utterly unaware, smiling with mercy.
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: Black-field next-episode card.
shots.sub: 三天后，九点整。一场开盘，一场开局——港海没人睡得着。
shots.card: 三天后，九点整。一场开盘，一场开局——港海没人睡得着。
